import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Set seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features (exclude 'Id' and 'Cover_Type' from train)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

# Encode target
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)

# Use full training data for CV and validation
X_train_full, X_val_full, y_train_full, y_val_full = train_test_split(
    X,
    y_encoded,
    test_size=0.15,
    stratify=y_encoded,
    random_state=42,
)

# Define LightGBM parameters optimized for speed and accuracy
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "min_child_samples": 50,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "subsample_freq": 1,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y_train_full)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_full, label=y_val_full, reference=train_data)

# Find optimal num_boost_round using cross-validation with early stopping callback
cv_results = lgb.cv(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    nfold=3,
    stratified=True,
    metrics="multi_logloss",
    seed=42,
    verbose_eval=False,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)
best_num_rounds = len(cv_results["multi_logloss-mean"])

print(f"Optimal number of boosting rounds: {best_num_rounds}")

# Train final model on training subset with optimal rounds (hold-out validation)
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=best_num_rounds,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validation prediction
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_full)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_preds, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_full, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_preds, axis=1)
inverse_pred_classes = le.inverse_transform(test_pred_classes)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test["Id"], "Cover_Type": inverse_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
